name: no-ultracode-prefix-for-an-acp-harness
description: With an ACP agent as the harness, a prompt is sent exactly as the person said it, even when the configured effort is Ultra ("max"). The agent starts fresh with its own command.
reason: "ultracode" is a Claude Code keyword. An unrelated agent would read it as part of the request, so a foreign keyword must never reach it.
source: DESIGN.md v2.1 A 'ACP harnesses and remote mode are NEVER prefixed'; DESIGN.md v2.0 'passes resumeSessionID: nil for ACP'; AppState.outgoingText(for:), AppState.startSession
